id: # Columns, the `on` grammar and driver keys: vault/architecture/guard-file-formats.md and
# vault/architecture/qg-builtin-drivers.md in the vault-quality-gates repo. quality/README.md
# describes every row in this repo. Empty cells are `-`.
# Every node tool runs through quality/bin/in-node.sh. Under commit it measures a copy of the staged
# tree with the main checkout's node_modules and a fresh copy of its .nuxt, so `pnpm install` must
# have run there; on push it measures this checkout as it is. Whole-suite rows run on `baseline`
# only: tests-failing, coverage and coverage-age-days read the reports the last `pnpm guard:suite`

why: A commit may not add an ESLint error or warning on the lines it adds, so lint debt only shrinks.

args: runner=quality/bin/in-node.sh files=changed include=\.(ts|tsx|mts|vue|js|mjs|cjs)$ lines=added bin=node_modules/.bin/vue-tsc -- -b --noEmit --pretty false
why: A commit may not add a TypeScript error on the lines it adds, so type errors never reach a release branch.
A commit may not add a line inside a block jscpd finds elsewhere in the repo, so shared logic is extracted instead of copied.

args: -- for e in ts tsx mts vue js mjs cjs; do "{{guard}}/guard-added-lines.sh" --ext "$e" --grep 'eslint-disable|@ts-(ignore|expect-error|nocheck)' --bases "{{bases}}" --target "{{target}}" || exit 2; done | awk -v list="${GUARD_LIST:-}" 'list != "" { print; next } { s += $1 } END { if (list == "") print s + 0 }'
why: A commit may not add an eslint-disable or @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error or @ts-nocheck comment, so a finding is fixed instead of hidden.
replaced by protected-paths-touched, which reads the longer protected list of quality/config
A commit may not change a protected gate or tool config file, so an agent cannot loosen the rules that judge it.
A commit may not change the locked version of a dev tool, an eslint plugin, nuxt or @nuxt/cli without a human override, so looser tools never arrive unseen.
The whole-repo ESLint error count may not rise above its baseline.
ESLint complexity, nesting, length and parameter-count findings may not rise above their baseline, so functions stay small enough to follow.
The whole-repo nuxt typecheck error count may not rise above its baseline.
Explicit imports that break the layer order of .dependency-cruiser.cjs may not rise above their baseline.
Unused files, exports and dependencies knip reports may not rise above their baseline, so dead code is removed rather than kept.
Breaches of the repo checks in eslint-rules/lib/repo-checks.cjs, such as untranslated copy or flags missing from .env.example, may not rise above their baseline.
Lines fallow finds duplicated, renamed copies included, may not rise above their baseline.
Layer violations fallow finds, Nuxt auto-imported calls included, may not rise above their baseline.
How far functions and Vue templates exceed cyclomatic 15 and cognitive 20, summed, may not rise above its baseline.
The share of duplicated lines may not rise more than 0.1 points above its baseline.
The number of duplicated blocks jscpd reports may not rise above its baseline.
A push may not go out while the last whole-suite run has a failing test.
Line coverage from the last whole-suite run may not drop more than half a point below its baseline.
The whole-suite reports may be at most seven days old, so tests-failing and coverage read a recent run.
replaced by tests-suite-failed, which counts the failed tests in the junit report instead of reading the exit code
The whole suite may not fail or miss a coverage threshold on a baseline run, and it writes the reports the push rows read.
The Stryker mutation score may not drop more than one point below its baseline, so the tests keep catching changed behaviour.
